lessons.title: Connect with care
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
Mobile data and Wi-Fi are different connections. Mobile data may use a paid allowance. Check which connection is active before downloading a large file. A familiar network name alone does not prove a network is trustworthy.

Practise: explain one action from this lesson in your own words. Then complete all three quiz questions to unlock the next lesson.
takeaways: Avoid sensitive activity until you trust it

lessons.title: Manage storage
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:

lessons.title: Make your phone accessible
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
Use the accessibility settings that suit you. You may be able to increase text size, enable a screen reader or use captions. Features differ across devices and applications. Test the change and adjust it if needed.
